message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from another person, intending to resell for profit. Then he deceived victim by promising high profit from buying and selling artifacts, got 5 million RMB, used money for personal purposes, gave back 1 million and some low-value artifacts. The artifacts are cultural relics, some are classified as level 3 (protected). The crimes likely: fraud (诈骗罪) and illegal trafficking of cultural relics (非法买卖文物) maybe "非法买卖文物罪" (selling prohibited cultural relics). Also possibly "非法买卖文物罪" is under Criminal Law article 277? Actually Chinese law: "非法买卖文物罪" (Article 277). Also "诈骗罪" (fraud). The prosecution says "构成××和诈骗罪". The placeholder likely includes "非法买卖文物罪". So answer: 诈骗;非法买卖文物. In examples they list multiple separated by semicolon. So final answer: [罪名]诈骗;非法买卖文物<eoa>
